name: Starline Cashback Wallet for WooCommerce
author: starlinewebsolu

sections.description:
Starline Cashback Wallet for WooCommerce adds a full-featured wallet and cashback system to your WooCommerce store. Customers earn cashback on purchases and progress through tier-based loyalty levels.

Features

  • Wallet System – Customers get a personal wallet with credit/debit functionality
  • Cashback Rewards – Percentage or fixed cashback on completed orders
  • Loyalty Points – Points-based loyalty program with configurable values
  • Tier System – Multi-level loyalty tiers based on wallet balance and anniversary spend
  • Checkout Redemption – Customers can redeem wallet balance at checkout
  • Store API Support – Full compatibility with WooCommerce Blocks and Store API
  • My Account Dashboard – Dedicated cashback dashboard for customers
  • Email Notifications – Automated emails for wallet credits, debits, and cashback events
  • Admin Management – Full admin dashboard with transaction logs, manual adjustments, and export
  • HPOS Compatible – Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • Multisite Compatible – Works across WordPress multisite networks
  • Translation Ready – Fully internationalized with .pot file
sections.installation:
1. Upload the starline-cashback-wallet-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Cashback Wallet menu in your WordPress admin to configure settings
  4. Configure cashback rates, and tier settings from the Settings page
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce Blocks / Cart / Checkout?

Yes, the plugin includes full Store API integration and works with WooCommerce Blocks for cart and checkout.

Is this compatible with HPOS?

Yes, the plugin fully declares HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility.

Does this support multisite?

Yes, the plugin fully supports WordPress multisite networks. Database tables are properly prefixed and installation/uninstallation runs across all sites.

How do I translate the plugin?

The plugin is fully internationalized. Copy the .pot file from /languages/ and translate using POEdit or Loco Translate.
